diagram_candidates.title: Dogleg path and trust-region boundary intersection
diagram_candidates.concrete_content: In a two-dimensional trust-region cross-section, show the origin, gradient direction, Cauchy point p_C on the boundary, Newton point p_N outside the ball, the segment p_C to p_N, its boundary intersection p_D, and the comparison of m(p_D) with m(p_C). Label the two early return branches.
diagram_candidates.check: Check the drawing against the stated positive-definite model and the branch order; it must not imply that the selected dogleg point is always p_D.

diagram_candidates.title: Bilinear graph and McCormick envelope over a box
diagram_candidates.concrete_content: Show the surface w=xy above a rectangular (x,y) box together with the two lower and two upper affine McCormick planes from the four inequalities; distinguish the product graph from the bounding polytope.
diagram_candidates.check: Check corner values and all four plane orientations against the displayed endpoint formulas; avoid suggesting the envelope equals the graph except at special cases.

diagram_candidates.title: A line segment of minimizing coefficients maps to one fitted value
